description: This file manages Zalouser accounts, including loading account runtime, merging configurations, resolving profiles, and providing functions to resolve, list, and authenticate accounts.

methods.name: loadZalouserAccountsRuntime
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the Zalouser accounts runtime module, caching the promise.

methods.name: mergeZalouserAccountConfig
methods.description: Merges account configuration with default values and policies.

methods.name: resolveProfile
methods.description: Resolves the profile string from config, environment variables, or defaults.

methods.name: resolveZalouserAccountBase
methods.description: Resolves base account info including accountId, enabled status, merged config, and profile.

methods.name: resolveZalouserAccount
methods.description: Resolves a Zalouser account with authentication check.

methods.name: resolveZalouserAccountSync
methods.description: Synchronously resolves a Zalouser account without authentication.

methods.name: getZcaUserInfo
methods.description: Fetches user info for a given profile.

methods.name: checkZcaAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if a profile is authenticated.
